filtering.scope: Each filtered row uses observations only through its own time; each predictive row uses only the preceding prefix. Log posterior messages stay in log space between steps. Probability outputs are numerically normalized and can underflow tiny entries to zero; observed log scores remain the authoritative likelihood representation. This batch prefix audit is not a persistent streaming session, smoothed inference or a model-quality guarantee.

smoothing.scope: Full-sequence smoothed state/adjacent-state marginals, not online filtering. Posterior modes maximize per-position marginals, not path probability; may violate zero-transition constraints. Posterior rows are numerically renormalized; input model probabilities are not.

viterbi.scope: Single maximum-joint-probability path, equivalently maximum posterior path for fixed observations. Exact local predecessor/final ties keep the first state index; not a promised lexicographic whole-path tie rule. Not per-position posterior modes or a guarantee of ground-truth state recovery.

prefix_forecast.scope: Horizon1 transitions once from the last conditioned state, then predicts its emission. Each horizon is a marginal conditioned on the observed prefix, not a joint future path or independent forecast. No guessed future observation is fed back as evidence. Numerically normalized probability outputs may underflow tiny entries. Fixed HMM assumptions, not a calibration, deployment or ground-truth guarantee.

result.scope: Fixed supplied HMM. Filtering uses each own prefix; smoothing/Viterbi use the complete displayed window. Forecast uses only the first cut observations; no guessed future evidence. The displayed window may be a prefix of an original test sequence, not the whole original sequence. State labels need not identify true states. No causal, calibration, new training or performance claim.
